evidence.reason: The current contract says `pytest.importorskip` flags only inside a visible `test*` function body; module level, fixtures, and helpers are dependency guards. At line 197, `inTestBody` is computed after `trackDefs` has processed the `def test_x(...)` signature, so an `importorskip` call in a default argument is incorrectly treated as being inside the test body. Python evaluates default arguments at definition time, outside the function body. This is a routine correctness defect in the existing intended behavior.
